motivation: r3 variant B (4h EMA20/200 ribbon long, enter only if daily ribbon != -1) had the best development Sharpe 1.14 but 28.8% intrabar DD, caused by a 2023 sideways whipsaw (14-loss streak; top 10 trades = 104% of gross). Test fixed chop filters, an ML forward-trend-efficiency filter, and a DD-targeted size.
disclosure: Variant B's development results were seen before this registration; its opened-year result is unseen. The r1 grid's opened-year result for the unfiltered 4h EMA20/200 ribbon long (+22.4%) was seen.

variants.R1: B with strict gate: daily ribbon == +1
variants.R3: B and 4h Kaufman efficiency ratio over the last 42 closes > 0.30 at entry
variants.R4: B and ML filter: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, max_iter=400, min_samples_leaf=100, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0) on base+candles+indicators features (plus daily context) at every 4h bar predicts forward efficiency ratio ER_fwd[t] = |log(c[t+42]/c[t])| / sum_{k=t+1..t+42} |log(c[k]/c[k-1])|; walk-forward refit every 540 bars from 2021-01-01; a row is trainable if t+42+12 < refit bar; enter only if prediction >= median of the fitted model's predictions on its own training rows

selection: among variants with walk-forward stress net > 0, highest validation Sharpe (normal)
risk_scale: k = min(1, 0.20 / pre_validation intrabar DD of the selected variant) rounded down to 0.05; constant size k; validation and opened year are out-of-sample for k
costs: ma_ribbon_r1 normal / stress / actual funding; fixed quantity at entry

acceptance.opened_year_check: selected+scaled variant: net > 0 under normal and stress, intrabar DD <= 20%; all variants reported unscaled and scaled
acceptance.then: freeze for prospective shadow; no live orders; 3% monthly is aspiration only
